modelBench.title: Model comparison
modelBench.subtitle: One prompt, the same material, several models side by side.
modelBench.ready: Select at least two models, then send a prompt to compare their answers.
modelBench.noModels: No available models. Add a provider and enable its models in Model settings.
modelBench.promptPlaceholder: What would you like every model to do?
modelBench.fileHint: TXT / MD / CSV / JSON · UTF-8 · up to 300 KB
modelBench.fileError: Choose a UTF-8 text, Markdown, CSV or JSON file up to 300 KB.
modelBench.validation: Select 2–4 available models and enter text. The combined input must be under 400 KB.
modelBench.saveError: Could not save. Keep this page open and try again.
modelBench.loadError: Could not load. Refresh or check that the updated backend is running.
modelBench.runError: This model failed. Check its settings or try again.
modelBench.waiting: Waiting for the model's first text…
modelBench.historyHint: Your latest 5 saved comparisons. Large records may reduce the number retained.

incompatibleRuntime.title: This system is not supported by the bundled backend
incompatibleRuntime.description: AionUi opened, but the local AionCore backend cannot run on this Linux version. Please upgrade to a supported Linux distribution and restart AionUi.

incompleteInstallation.title: AionUi installation is incomplete
incompleteInstallation.description: This installation is missing required local resources, so AionCore cannot start. Please download and reinstall the latest AionUi. If the issue returns after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined AionCore.
incompleteInstallation.runtimeComponentDescription: This installation is missing required bundled runtime components, so {{resource}} cannot start. Reinstall the latest AionUi package. If it still happens after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined AionUi components.

packageArchitectureMismatch.title: AionUi package architecture mismatch
packageArchitectureMismatch.description: This AionUi package is for {{packageArch}}, but this Mac is {{deviceArch}}. You may have downloaded the wrong package. Please download and install the {{expectedArch}} package.

dataMigration.title: Local data migration failed
dataMigration.description: AionUi opened, but AionCore stopped while initializing local data. Reinstalling AionUi may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database migration can be inspected.

databaseNewerThanApp.title: A newer version of AionUi is required
databaseNewerThanApp.description: Your local data was created by a newer version of AionUi, and this version can't open it. Update AionUi to the latest version to continue — your data is intact, and no reinstall or data reset is needed.
databaseNewerThanApp.descriptionWithVersion: Your local data was created by a version of AionUi newer than the one installed now (v{{currentVersion}}), so this version can't open it. Update AionUi to the latest version to continue — your data is intact, and no reinstall or data reset is needed.

localDataRepair.title: Local data repair failed
localDataRepair.description: AionUi opened, but AionCore stopped while preparing local startup data such as assistant or agent records. Reinstalling AionUi may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database can be inspected.

startupDirectory.title: Startup directory is unavailable
startupDirectory.description: AionUi opened, but AionCore could not start because the configured work or log directory is missing, unavailable, or blocked by permissions. Check that the configured directories exist and are writable, then restart AionUi.

recoverableDatabaseCorruption.title: Local data is corrupted
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.description: AionUi detected that the local database is corrupted and cannot continue startup. After confirmation, AionUi will back up the old database and create a new local database to continue startup. Past conversations will no longer be shown, and the old database will be kept as a backup file.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.confirmRebuild: Back up old DB and rebuild new DB
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.diagnosticsHint: Sending diagnostics will not modify the local database.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.rebuildFailed: Failed to back up old DB and rebuild new DB

confirmDialog.title: Rebuild the database?
confirmDialog.content: This will back up the currently corrupted database and create a brand-new empty one. Past conversations will no longer be shown (the old database is kept as a backup file). Continue?

transientConcurrentStartup.title: AionUi is starting up
transientConcurrentStartup.description: Another AionUi startup was still using the local data when this window opened. This is temporary and your data is safe — no reinstall is needed. Please wait a moment and try again, or restart AionUi.
transientConcurrentStartup.diagnosticsHint: If this keeps happening, you can send a diagnostics report.

pendingSlow.title: Starting up
pendingSlow.description: AionCore is starting up, please wait. If it doesn't respond after a while, you can quit and reopen the app.

exited.title: Startup didn't complete
exited.description: AionCore couldn't finish starting and has exited. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
exited.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry

portReportTimeout.title: Startup timed out
portReportTimeout.description: AionCore didn't finish starting within the expected time. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
portReportTimeout.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry

startupFailed.title: Startup failed
startupFailed.description: AionCore failed to start. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
startupFailed.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry

workbench.title: Workbench
workbench.accountHint: Each account has its own profile. Closing a window preserves login data.
workbench.loginHint: Sign in on the right. Login data stays on this device. Expired sessions require signing in again.
workbench.pageError: Page failed to load. Check your connection and retry.
workbench.saveError: Could not save changes. Check local storage and retry.
workbench.storageError: Could not read account data. Existing profiles have been preserved.
workbench.desktopOnly: Use the desktop app to open account browsers.
workbench.welcome: What would you like to work on?

feishuAuth.title: Feishu authorization
feishuAuth.loginRequired: Sign in to the local CLI
feishuAuth.notInstalled: Install the official lark-cli locally, then check again
feishuAuth.notConfigured: Run lark-cli config init locally to configure a Feishu application
feishuAuth.error: Could not verify authorization. Check the CLI configuration and network, then retry.
feishuAuth.pending: Complete authorization in the browser, then click “I have authorized”
feishuAuth.description: Uses the local lark-cli. Credentials stay with the CLI. Authorization requests only comment-table reading, writing and wiki lookup.

replySync.title: Comment replies
replySync.setupHint: Create a separate “Comment replies” table in the current Base, keeping existing tables and content.
replySync.partial: Some comments have not fully loaded. Try later or view them on the platform; unloaded comments are not treated as deleted.
replySync.bindHint: Open your own published work in an account browser on the right, then choose “Bind current work” for that account.
replySync.error: Sync could not finish. Check your platform login, Feishu authorization and the work page, then retry.

errors.replyButtonVerificationRequired: The platform requires identity verification. Complete verification in the account browser on the right, then verify the send result.
errors.replyManualModeRequired: Only manual sending is supported. Click Send comments in the toolbar.
errors.replySendButtonRequired: Arrange the reply table in Settings first, then click Send comments in the toolbar.
errors.replyVerificationRequired: The platform requires identity verification. Complete verification in the account browser on the right, then verify the send result.
errors.replyAccountMismatch: The signed-in account does not match the bound work. Check the account on the right and open its own published work.
errors.replyDraftPresent: The comment box already has a draft. It has been preserved. Handle that draft before continuing sync.
errors.replyTargetUnavailable: The target comment is unavailable. Open the matching work and check whether the comment has loaded or was deleted.
errors.replyBrowserClosed: This account browser is closed. Reopen it to continue syncing.
errors.replyBrowserBusy: This account is performing another operation. Try again shortly.
errors.replyApprovalInterrupted: This reply was not sent because sending was interrupted. Check My reply, then click Send comments in the toolbar again.
errors.replyStoreInvalid: Local reply records cannot be read. Preserve existing data and repair the records before continuing.
errors.replyResultPending: The result is saved, but its Feishu status has not been updated. Choose “Verify send results” to update it without resending.
errors.replyArchiveUncertain: The result of saving comments to Feishu is unconfirmed. Choose “Verify send results”; do not manually duplicate or recreate these records yet.
errors.replySendUncertain: The send result is unconfirmed. Choose “Verify send results” and do not send the same reply again.
errors.replyPresentationConflict: Conflicting view or workflow settings were found and preserved. Check them before arranging the reply table again.
errors.replyPresentationUnverified: The reply table settings are not fully verified. Retry Arrange reply table.
errors.replyCliFailed: Could not arrange the Feishu table. Check authorization and your connection, then retry.
errors.replyFieldSchemaChanged: The reply table columns have changed. Check the table and retry arranging it; existing content is preserved.
errors.replyInvalidResponse: Feishu returned incomplete information. Retry arranging the table later.
errors.replyPauseRequired: Wait for the current operation to finish before arranging the table.
errors.replyButtonApprovalInterrupted: This reply was not sent because sending was interrupted. Check My reply, then click Send comments in the toolbar again.
errors.replyOwnComment: This is a historical comment from your own account, not a customer reply target. The record is preserved and cannot be sent to.
errors.replyCommentLinkInvalid: This comment link is invalid or no longer matches a local record. Sync comments and open its Original comment link again.
errors.replyDraftChanged: The reply record changed and was not sent. Check the original comment and “My reply”, then retry.
errors.replyThreadIncomplete: The replies to this comment have not fully loaded. Nothing was sent. Try later or reply on the platform.
errors.replySourceIdentityChanged: The Feishu comment source could not be verified. Existing data was kept. Check the original record’s source fields and retry.
errors.replyDuplicateWork: This platform account’s work is already linked in another browser account. Use the originally linked account.
errors.replyDuplicateComment: Multiple records refer to the same comment. This reply was stopped. Check the original records first.

replySync.authReadyHint: Authorization completed. Retry the previous action.
replySync.configureHint: Show six columns: User, Time, Comment, Original comment, My reply, and Status. Preserve existing records and enable toolbar sending.
replySync.manualRuntimeHint: Each Send comments click snapshots the current filled drafts for unanswered comments and sends them sequentially. Later additions or edits need another click. Sync comments never sends replies.
replySync.feishuReplyPath: In Feishu: fill My reply, then click Send comments in the Workbench toolbar to send the filled drafts for unanswered comments.
replySync.platformReplyPath: On the platform: click View comment in Original comment to open the matching account and reply there.
replySync.replyBackfillHint: On the next comment sync, verified platform replies replace the Feishu draft and show Replied. Those rows will not be sent again.
replySync.commentLinkHint: Exact comment location requires opening the link inside Workbench. Outside Workbench, it opens only the work.

workbench.boundAccountCannotDelete: This account is linked to a work and cannot be deleted.
workbench.accountBindingCheckFailed: Cannot check whether this account is linked to a work. Please try again.
workbench.deleteAccountDescription: The account will be removed from the list. Its login data remains on this device, but the account cannot be restored in the interface.
